data.content: Bug report: behind trusted proxies, c.ClientIP() returns the proxy's address instead of the client's. With the header `X-Forwarded-For: 20.20.20.20, 30.30.30.30` and 30.30.30.30 configured as a trusted proxy, ClientIP() should return 20.20.20.20. Find and fix the bug in the library code (do not modify tests). Verify with `go test ./...`. When done, reply with a one-line summary of the fix.

data.content: All tests pass. Fix: in `gin.go`'s `validateHeader`, the trusted-proxy check was inverted (`isTrustedProxy(ip)` instead of `!isTrustedProxy(ip)`), causing it to stop at the proxy's own IP; corrected to walk back through trusted proxies until it finds the actual untrusted client IP.
